Read files from AWS S3 bucket.

**Status:** Can't run yet (Coming soon): the node is listed under **Can't run yet** in the palette and cannot be added to a graph.

Downloads and reads files from Amazon S3 buckets. Supports various file formats (CSV, Parquet, JSON).

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| bucket | `bucket` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | S3 bucket name. |
| key | `key` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Object key (file path) |
| region | `region` | Text | `us-east-1` |   | The run | AWS region. |
| access_key | `access_key` | Password | (empty) |   | The run | AWS access key ID. |
| secret_key | `secret_key` | Password | (empty) |   | The run | AWS secret access key. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.
